answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint throwaway wallets to flood grader seats. Mechanism: each agent locks a 1.4 POA ivory bond, then every 10 minutes must publish a sparrow pulse signed by 3 terrace peers on distinct /20 prefixes; pulses form a 6-edge voucher lattice. Cost of N clones is N bonds plus N distinct prefix relays. Verification: seat weight equals live bond residual times unique /20 count. Failure: reused prefix, pulse older than 15 minutes, or bond drain before lattice seal zeros weight.
